status: benchmark conventions; historical source conventions remain preserved alongside these

vehicle_orientation.driver: left side of vehicle when seated facing forward
vehicle_orientation.passenger: right side of vehicle when seated facing forward

cam_rotation.viewpoint: looking from the rear of the truck toward the front
cam_rotation.warning: A historical front-looking-back label reverses CW/CCW and must not be silently converted.

pivot_motion.note: in/out motion is a physical displacement and is stored independently from cam-bolt rotation word.

alignment_sign.warning: historical user-dictated left/right row order must be retained even where it conflicts with script sign.

sweep_model.alpha: steering-wheel rotation in radians, positive right in recovered script
sweep_model.theta: individual road-wheel yaw in radians, positive right in recovered script

large_candidate_jacobian.rows: driver camber positions 0..6, then passenger positions 0..6
large_candidate_jacobian.basis: coordinate basis of named state components; no orthonormal physical configuration-space basis is claimed
